source_definition: The source is a connected graph of diameter at most four. Its outputs are nontrivial cuts having exactly one opposite neighbor at every vertex, or NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: Both problems ask for a nontrivial bipartition with exactly one opposite neighbor per vertex, or NO-SOLUTION. The connected source graph has diameter at most four; the connected target graph has diameter at most three.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
